name: Water Main Breach & Flooding Protocol
description: Orchestrates isolation of pressurized water mains, sub-basement flood mitigation, electrical hazard de-energization, emergency plumbing dispatch, and occupant notification.

steps.description: Trace water loop isolation valves and identify downstream dependent facilities (such as cooling loops or labs).
Search and dispatch emergency industrial plumbing contractor with high-volume submersible pump capability.
Issue urgent flood and utility outage advisories to building facility managers and safety officers.
Open structural moisture remediation, dehumidification, and electrical safety sign-off work orders.
Record valve shutoff response times, water ingress points, and contractor efficiency into institutional memory.

name: Critical Environment Climate Control Failure
description: Emergency protocol for temperature excursions in sensitive environments like neonatal intensive care, research bio-banks, or server rooms.

steps.description: Check current ambient vs setpoint temperatures across all hospital/lab zones and verify backup chillers.
Immediate P1 notification to clinical charge nurses and biomedical engineering leadership.
Dispatch priority HVAC emergency crew with standby spot coolers and chiller bypass rigs.
Track hourly temperature recovery and chiller loop pressure equalization.
Log thermal gradient progression and chiller inter-tie lessons for future seasonal transitions.

name: Campus Electrical Substation Failure & Generator Transfer
description: Manages primary switchgear trips, diesel turbine load pickup, elevator entrapment sweeps, and priority restoration.

steps.description: Identify unpowered buildings, check generator fuel reserves, and query elevator occupancy status.
Dispatch high-voltage electrical engineering team for substation breaker diagnostics.
Broadcast campus-wide power disruption bulletin and life-safety instructions.
Assign building marshals to perform physical sweeps of all elevator shafts.
Record electrical surge characteristics and emergency generator cutover timestamps.

name: Fire Alarm Activation & Evacuation Management
description: Rapid response to smoke/thermal detector trips, municipal dispatch verification, and occupant evacuation.

steps.description: Determine current headcount in affected building and confirm evacuation path clearance.
Send immediate emergency mass notification to evacuate building to designated assembly zones.
Generate municipal Fire Incident Log and verify riser water pressure records for the fire marshal.
Ensure alarm panel reset and sprinkler head replacement by certified life safety technicians.
Document false alarm triggers or true ignition points and evacuation clearance duration.

name: Contractor Default & Emergency Replacement Protocol
description: Handles missed maintenance windows, updates vendor reliability metrics, penalizes SLA breaches, and re-routes work.

steps.description: Review vendor contract SLA terms and count past no-show occurrences in the current quarter.
Identify alternate rated contractor available for same-day emergency dispatch.
Flag contractual default and prepare formal SLA liquidated damages notice.
Reduce vendor reliability score in Memory Bank and place on probationary dispatch status.

name: Unauthorized Access & Physical Security Breach
description: Addresses forced entry, badge access anomalies in restricted research zones, and perimeter lockouts.

steps.description: Lock down affected building magnetic doors and query access log sensor events.
Alert campus police dispatch and building security supervisor.
Dispatch access control hardware specialist if physical hardware or turnstiles were compromised.
Conduct full badge audit and re-key compromised physical cores.
Record vulnerability vector and tailgating patterns in institutional memory.

name: Elevator Stoppage & Occupant Rescue Protocol
description: Immediate life-safety response to stalled vertical mobility cabs with entrapped occupants.

steps.description: Determine exact shaft number, floor level, cab ventilation status, and occupant count.
Dispatch emergency elevator rescue technician under 1-hour priority SLA.
Establish continuous two-way audio contact with trapped occupants and alert local fire rescue if needed.
Tag out elevator bank until mandatory state safety recertification is completed.
Record governor trip causes, rescue response time, and maintenance history.

name: Regulatory Audit & Inspection Preparation
description: Automates pre-audit document assembly, citation remediation verification, and pre-inspection physical walks.

steps.description: Retrieve audit requirements, scheduled agency dates, and past outstanding citations.
Compile digital compliance binder with testing logs and engineering sign-offs.
Assign pre-inspection walkthrough with facility supervisor to verify physical hazard clearance.
Query institutional memory for inspector-specific preferences and past audit pain points.
